_comment: Ground truth list curated from documented OWASP Juice Shop and DVWA vulnerability challenges. is_vulnerable=true are verified exploitable lab flaws; is_vulnerable=false are scanner false positives / non-exploitable endpoints; needs_review=true flags ambiguous scanner alerts.

findings.description: SQL Injection in SQLite product search (Database Schema / User Credentials challenges)
Reflected / DOM XSS in search query (DOM XSS challenge)
Angular SPA client-side DOM XSS route
SQL Injection in login authentication (Login Admin challenge)
IDOR / BOLA horizontal privilege escalation reading arbitrary user baskets (View Basket challenge)
IDOR / BOLA horizontal privilege escalation reading User B basket 7
SSRF via profile image URL upload to internal/external networks (SSRF challenge)
DVWA Blind SQL Injection on id parameter via MySQL SLEEP
User registration uses parameterized Sequelize ORM queries; SQLi payload in email does not execute
Basket items management uses parameterized Sequelize ORM queries
Address retrieval enforces authorization via security.isAuthorized() and returns HTTP 400 on cross-user access
Address 7 retrieval enforces authorization via security.isAuthorized() and returns HTTP 400 on cross-user access
Address 8 retrieval enforces authorization via security.isAuthorized() and returns HTTP 400 on cross-user access
Angular contact route properly context-encodes input; no JavaScript execution observed
Order tracking parameter performs local database query only; does not issue outbound HTTP requests
Password parameter is hashed after user lookup; not SQL-injectable
Customer feedback submission uses parameterized Sequelize ORM models
ZAP Rule 10038: Content Security Policy (CSP) header missing on image upload endpoint (missing defense-in-depth header, not exploitable flaw)
ZAP Rule 10038: CSP header missing on login endpoint
ZAP Rule 10038: CSP header missing on API Users endpoint
ZAP Rule 10098: Cross-Domain Misconfiguration / CORS header alert on public registration API
ZAP Rule 10098: Cross-Domain Misconfiguration / CORS header alert on feedback API
ZAP Rule 10098: CORS header alert on product search
ZAP Rule 2: Private IP disclosure in profile response header/comments; requires manual verification if considered challenge flaw
ZAP Rule 90022: Information disclosure via server/error banner; requires verification against challenge definitions
